verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, so committing and pushing code from the device is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions git, commit, or push. The listed commands (python3, lua, clang, pdflatex, pkg-installed zip/ffmpeg) do not include version control, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can commit and push changes directly from my device
